#!/bin/zsh
# Poll githubstatus for GitHub Actions recovery. On recovery, rerun the failed
# jobs of the target run. Bounded to ~9 min per invocation (Bash tool timeout cap),
# so it is safe to re-arm repeatedly until it reports RECOVERED.

REPO="joelmoss/workroom"
RUN_ID="31117805020"
BUDGET=540          # seconds of polling per invocation
INTERVAL=60

check() {
  curl -s --max-time 20 https://www.githubstatus.com/api/v2/summary.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print("ERR|could not parse status payload"); sys.exit(0)

comp = next((c for c in d.get("components", []) if c["name"] == "Actions"), None)
cstat = comp["status"] if comp else "unknown"

acted = [i for i in d.get("incidents", [])
         if i.get("status") != "resolved"
         and ("action" in i.get("name", "").lower()
              or any(c["name"] == "Actions" for c in i.get("components", [])))]

if cstat == "operational" and not acted:
    print("CLEAR|Actions component operational, no unresolved Actions incident")
else:
    names = "; ".join(i["name"] + " (" + i["status"] + ")" for i in acted) or "no incident listed"
    print("DEGRADED|component=" + cstat + " | " + names)
'
}

start=$SECONDS
while true; do
  res="$(check)"
  state="${res%%|*}"
  detail="${res#*|}"

  if [[ "$state" == "CLEAR" ]]; then
    echo "RECOVERED: $detail"
    echo "Rerunning failed jobs of run $RUN_ID"
    gh run rerun "$RUN_ID" --repo "$REPO" --failed 2>&1 || echo "rerun command errored"
    exit 0
  fi

  elapsed=$(( SECONDS - start ))
  if (( elapsed >= BUDGET )); then
    echo "STILL DEGRADED after ${elapsed}s: $detail"
    exit 3
  fi
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done
